bass.tags: Lo-fi hip hop. A Rhodes electric piano plays a jazz-influenced progression with a heavy tremolo effect and high-frequency roll-off. The drum kit features a muffled, low-pass filtered kick drum and a crisp, dry snare with a slight swing. A sub-bass synth follows the root notes of the piano chords. A recurring melodic motif is played on a clean electric guitar with a chorus effect and long reverb tail. Vinyl crackle and static noise are layered throughout the arrangement. The tempo is 85 BPM in the key of C minor.
bass.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[vinyl crackle and static noise]
[muffled Rhodes electric piano enters with tremolo]

[Main Theme]
[low-pass filtered kick drum and dry snare enter with swung rhythm]
[sub-bass synth enters]
[clean electric guitar with chorus and reverb plays melodic motif]

[Bridge]
[drums drop out]
[Rhodes piano continues with filtered frequency sweep]

[Outro]
[guitar motif fades out]
[drums and bass exit]
[Rhodes piano and vinyl crackle fade to silence]

drums.tags: Hard rock with heavy metal influences. Distorted electric guitars play palm-muted chugging riffs and power chords. The bass guitar follows the guitar riffs with a thick, overdriven tone. Drums feature a prominent double-kick pedal pattern and heavy crash cymbal accents. A high-pitched male vocal utilizes a gritty, raspy delivery with occasional melodic soaring. The arrangement includes a technical guitar solo with rapid alternate picking and vibrato. Key of E minor. Tempo 140 BPM. 4/4 time signature.
drums.prompt:
[Intro]
[distorted electric guitar chugging riff, double-kick drums enter]

[Verse 1]
[raspy male vocals]
I'm a man on a mission
With a heart of steel
I'm a force of nature
And I'm coming for the kill [guitar slide]

[Chorus]
[full band intensity, crash cymbals]
I'm the king of the mountain
I'm the lord of the land
I'm the master of my destiny
With the world in my hand

[Guitar Solo]
[fast alternate picking, wah-wah pedal effect]

[Outro]
[sustained power chord, feedback swell]

vocals.tags: Cinematic orchestral score. The arrangement features a prominent string section with staccato violins and violas playing a repetitive rhythmic ostinato. A solo cello performs a melodic line in the lower register. Sustained brass pads from horns and trombones provide harmonic density. Orchestral percussion includes deep, resonant timpani hits on the downbeats and a subtle, high-frequency metallic shimmer from a triangle or mark tree. The piece is in the key of D minor at 85 BPM in 4/4 time. The dynamics utilize a gradual crescendo through the layering of woodwinds, specifically oboe and flute, which double the string melody. The mix features a large hall reverb with a long decay time.
vocals.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[staccato string ostinato, low cello melody]

[Section A]
[sustained brass pads enter, timpani hits on downbeats]

[Section B]
[oboe and flute double the melody, crescendo, mark tree shimmer]

[Outro]
[brass and woodwinds fade, solo staccato violins remain, final timpani strike]
